summary: Every Report and both index pages attribute the zero assurance-verified Stories to LE-09 (no hardware tier), and that attribution is wrong for nine of them. STORY-P0-02-03, P0-03-01, P0-03-03, P0-05-01, P0-06-01, P0-06-02, P0-06-03, P0-07-01 and P0-07-02 select only domains whose catalogue tier names no T1 or T2 at all. Eight of the nine name HIL, which this project also lacks -- but STORY-P0-05-01 selects D09 alone, whose 23 release gates are every one of them Host+T0, hardware that already exists. Whether all 23 actually close is unproven and needs an audit rather than an assumption; G08 wants retired-instruction, branch-miss and L1D-miss counts that QEMU TCG cannot give, so it may be Host-only, and G22 is a 72-hour soak. AUDIT FIRST PASS (handover 28) mechanically confirms the nine and adds the sharper finding: eight of them select only Host+T0+HIL domains (D06 D07 D11 D12 D13) and HIL is NOT the Pi 5 -- the HIL rigs are CAN/USB hardware-in-the-loop, deferred to Phase 3 once the bus stack exists. So closing LE-09 will not move those eight, and the attribution is not merely wrong today, it stays wrong after LE-09 closes. STORY-P0-05-01 remains the sole candidate: D09 alone, tier Host+T0, no HIL row at all
owner_path: An audit Story: establish per-Story what actually blocks verified, and attempt STORY-P0-05-01 as the one candidate needing no hardware purchase

summary: The spine records one all-or-nothing assurance state per Story, so a Story with 20 of its 23 release gates closed is indistinguishable from one with none. summary: ADR 0004 decides that x86_64 cannot carry a worst-case latency bound -- SMIs are invisible unmaskable and unattributable so any WCET stated on x86_64 is a claim about the firmware -- but nothing mechanical enforces that decision. A Report can quote an x86_64 or Tier 0 QEMU number as a G04-class observed-maximum or WCET bound and every gate in this repository stays green. The ADR states the prohibition in prose (its consequences section forbids PROMOTING an x86_64 measurement into a worst-case bound while explicitly leaving the measurements themselves valid) and prose is weaker than a gate. This is LE-28 s failure mode in a second place: a correct decision with no machine behind it
